meta_title: Nephrite: The emerald standard for your browser
meta_description: A calm, low-glare jade theme for Chrome, Firefox and VS Code, with a variant for any light.
hero_body: A free, low-glare theme for Chrome and Firefox. Muted jade on every surface, so your eyes can rest while you work.
variants_title: Pick the green that fits your light.
variants_body: Forest for late nights, Jade for long days, Mint for daylight. Installing another variant replaces the current one, so trying them costs a click.
details_title: Designed for the hours you spend in your browser.
detail_eyes_body: Muted greens and tuned contrast keep long sessions comfortable, from the first tab to the fortieth.
detail_surfaces_body: Nephrite colors the parts of your browser you look at all day.
detail_open_body: Every color lives in a public repository. Fork it, tweak it, send a pull request.
rm_chrome_body: The flagship theme, in every variant.
rm_firefox_body: The same jade palette for tabs, toolbar, menus and sidebar, in every variant.
rm_vscode_body: Syntax and interface colors from the same palette, for long coding sessions.
rm_spotify_body: A quieter player to match the rest of your desk, through Spicetify.
rm_terminal_body: Color schemes for Windows Terminal, iTerm2, Alacritty, Kitty, Ghostty, Warp and WezTerm.
closing_body: Now on Chrome, Firefox and VS Code.
footer_tagline: The emerald standard for your browser.
shot_alt: A browser with the {name} theme applied
og_image_alt: Nephrite, a jade theme for Chrome, shown on a browser window
ports_meta_title: Nephrite ports: jade themes for your apps
ports_meta_description: Every app with a Nephrite theme, and the ones on the way: Chrome, Firefox and VS Code today, more soon.
ports_body: Jade themes for the apps you use every day, from your browser to your terminal.
ports_request_body: Tell us which one you want themed next.
palette_meta_title: The Nephrite palette: jade colors for themes and ports
palette_meta_description: Three flavors, ten jade-tinted neutrals and nine mineral accents, each above 4.5:1 contrast. Copy the colors as CSS or JSON.
palette_body: Three flavors, ten jade-tinted neutrals and nine accents named after minerals. Every accent clears 4.5:1 contrast on its base.
flavor_forest_desc: Deep and dark, for late nights
flavor_jade_desc: Dark with more green, for long days
palette_copy_hint: Select a color to copy its hex.
palette_export_body: Copy the flavor as CSS variables or JSON and start a port.
palette_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the value and copy it manually.
